title: Open-aired synthesis of star-shaped poly[2-(methacryloyloxy)ethyl trimethylammonium chloride]
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7649-7655
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00674K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tomasz Fronczyk, Anna Mielańczyk, Olesya Klymenko, Dorota Neugebauer
An easy, efficient, and oxygen-resistant synthesis of eight-arm star-shaped PMETAs was described. The surface properties of the PMETAs coatings varied depending on rotational speed of spin coater, polymer arm length and polymer concentration.
